WITH genre_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    GenreId, 
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price, 
    AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL 
        THEN CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds 
        ELSE NULL END) as ratio_avg
  FROM Track 
  WHERE GenreId IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY GenreId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) as overall_ratio_avg
  FROM genre_stats
  WHERE ratio_avg IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_genres AS (
  SELECT 
    g.avg_price,
    g.ratio_avg,
    g.ratio_avg - o.overall_ratio_avg as difference
  FROM genre_stats g
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE g.ratio_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND o.overall_ratio_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND g.ratio_avg > o.overall_ratio_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_price) as avg_of_prices,
  AVG(ratio_avg) as avg_of_ratios,
  AVG(difference) as avg_of_differences
FROM filtered_genres
